tool_args.rationale: The probe resolved branch behavior and the seven rows vary both input and sink gradient, supporting the four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon. The prior execution error was an implementation issue (an undefined training-data global), not evidence against the model; this version fits directly from fit(train_rows) and predicts using the fitted parameters, allowing fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: This batch is indicated for the distinct coupled-memory ODE family requiring at least eight rows; evidence and signatures instead support the four-parameter barrier law, and an additional purchase is unnecessary before fresh confirmation.
The acquired probe already spans low and high sink gradients and varied input, resolving the branch ambiguity sufficiently for a numerical fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static Michaelis, quadratic, or logistic response
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These ignore the observed sink-gradient variation and/or barrier-activation signature.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation or a coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations share H=0.7, with no slow-horizon reversal signature; the supplied mechanism evidence points to the barrier-modulated siphon instead.
